records.new_gloss_en: a device that reads images or text and converts them into digital data

sources.cg_qa_reason: Device definition fits 扫描仪/扫描器; not confused with scanning action.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: 定义以设备功能界定（读取图像或文字并转为数字数据），与中文“扫描仪；扫描器”对齐；扫描仪作人（收银扫描员）的罕见用法不在本 KU 的中文范围内，不构成遗漏。

records.new_gloss_en: in the middle of or surrounded by something

sources.cg_qa_reason: Locative/surrounding sense fits 在……之中; other figurative uses do not negate this sense.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: 介词定义“在……之中或被……包围”覆盖 amid the crowd 与 amid concerns 两类典型搭配，中文“在……之中”与之对齐，无义项窄化。

records.new_gloss_en: a metric unit of volume equal to 1,000 milliliters

sources.cg_qa_reason: Volume unit and 1,000 mL conversion are exact.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “公制容量单位，等于 1,000 毫升”在数值与单位属性上准确；中文补“（容量单位）”消除了“升”作动词（上升）的歧义可能。

records.new_gloss_en: a building or room equipped for exercise, physical training, or indoor sports

sources.cg_qa_reason: Exercise/training room or indoor-sport building covers the supplied facility senses.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “配备运动、体能训练或室内运动设施的建筑或房间”覆盖健身房与体育馆两义；中文两项均属场所义，与定义一致。

records.new_gloss_en: a word used to name a person, place, thing, idea, or quality

sources.cg_qa_reason: Names a person/place/thing/idea/quality; standard grammatical noun definition.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “用于命名人、地点、事物、观念或性质的词”是标准语法定义，四类所指覆盖名词的核心外延，无事实错误。

records.new_gloss_en: the ability of two things to work well together or exist together without conflict

sources.cg_qa_reason: Coexistence without conflict and functional interoperability both supported.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “两个事物能良好协作或无冲突共存的能力”同时覆盖技术兼容与人际相容，中文“兼容性；相容性”两项均被覆盖，无偏向一侧。

records.new_gloss_en: the process of bringing separate groups or parts together to form one whole

sources.cg_qa_reason: Process of joining separate groups/parts captures 统一/合并/一体化.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “把分离的群体或部分合成为一个整体的过程”覆盖政治统一与一般合并，中文“统一；合并；一体化”三项均属该过程的不同表述。

records.new_gloss_en: an early model of a product or design made to test or develop its features

sources.cg_qa_reason: Early test model of design/product captures 原型/样机 in this context.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “为测试或开发功能而制的产品或设计的早期模型”准确刻画原型；“早期模型”已含首版试制义，无需另立“理想范例”引申义。

records.new_gloss_en: in addition to what has already been mentioned

sources.cg_qa_reason: Supplementary discourse marker, not sequence marker, aligns 此外/另外.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “除已提及内容之外”准确表达副词的附加语义；中文补“另外”与“此外”同义，不扩大义项。

records.new_gloss_en: an entrance or a point through which people, things, or information can pass

sources.cg_qa_reason: Entrance or passage point is valid for physical and network gateway, but distinguish the technical sense during specialized teaching.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “人、物或信息可通过的入口或通道点”同时覆盖实体门户与网络网关，信息可通过一语使技术义自然成立，无需另立网关义。

records.new_gloss_en: a short test or set of questions used to check knowledge

sources.cg_qa_reason: Short knowledge-check test captures 小测验; 问答 is broader but acceptable as contextual near-synonym, not exhaustive equivalence.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “用于检查知识的简短测验或一组问题”覆盖小测验与问答两项中文；“简短”符合 quiz 区别于 exam 的典型特征。

records.new_gloss_en: things that are no longer wanted and are thrown away

sources.cg_qa_reason: Discarded unwanted materials matches 垃圾/废物.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “不再需要而被丢弃的东西”准确表达垃圾的字面义；中文“垃圾；废物”均属被丢弃物范畴。

records.new_gloss_en: a photograph or brief record showing a particular moment

sources.cg_qa_reason: Quick photo or point-in-time record supports 快照 and software analogy.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “呈现某一时刻的照片或简要记录”同时覆盖照片快照与“经济快照”类比喻用法；中文补“瞬间记录”使比喻义有据可依。

records.new_gloss_en: to calculate a result using numbers or data

sources.cg_qa_reason: Calculate using numbers/data is correct mathematical/computational verb.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “用数字或数据计算结果”准确表达动词义；“用数据”一语使计算机处理义自然成立，无需另立计算义。

records.new_gloss_en: one of several levels or ranks in an ordered system

sources.cg_qa_reason: One level in ordered hierarchy fits 层/级.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “有序系统中的若干等级之一”准确表达层级义；中文“层级；等级”与定义中的 levels/ranks 对应。

records.new_gloss_en: official permission, often shown in a passport, to enter or stay in a country

sources.cg_qa_reason: Official authorization to apply for entry/stay, subject to border discretion; current language does not promise guaranteed admission.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “通常显示在护照上、准许进入或居留某国的官方许可”准确；often 一词为电子签等非贴纸形式留了余地，定义不过度断言。

records.new_gloss_en: a symbol or design used to identify a company, organization, or product

sources.cg_qa_reason: Identifying graphic symbol/design fits 标志/徽标.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “用于标识公司、组织或产品的符号或设计”标准且完整；中文两项顺序调整不改变义项。

records.new_gloss_en: to stop, catch, or take something while it is traveling from one place to another

sources.cg_qa_reason: Stop/catch something in transit supports 拦截/截获.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “在某物从一地前往另一地途中将其拦下、截获”覆盖体育抢断、导弹拦截与信息截获；中文补“截获”使中途夺取义明确。

records.new_gloss_en: the elected or appointed leader of a city or town government

sources.cg_qa_reason: City/town civic leader is correct across election/appointment jurisdictions.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “经选举或任命的市镇政府领导人”覆盖不同政体的市长产生方式；elected or appointed 的并列避免了只认选举制的片面。

records.new_gloss_en: a unit of length equal to 1,000 meters

sources.cg_qa_reason: Exactly 1,000 meters, and Chinese synonyms correct.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “等于 1,000 米的长度单位”数值准确；中文“千米；公里”均为该单位的标准译名。

records.new_gloss_en: causing physical pain or emotional distress

sources.cg_qa_reason: Physical pain or emotional suffering meets source meanings.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “引起身体疼痛或情感痛苦”同时覆盖生理与情感两类用法；中文“疼痛的；痛苦的”两项各有对应。

records.new_gloss_en: in a formal or authorized way, or according to an official statement

sources.cg_qa_reason: Formal authorization/official-status sense valid, though not every formal act is 'official'.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “以正式或授权方式，或根据官方声明”覆盖 officially announced 与 officially approved 两类副词用法。

records.new_gloss_en: able to be changed in size, position, or amount to suit a need

sources.cg_qa_reason: Capable of changing dimensions/amounts fits 可调节的.
sources.mu_enlex_reason: “可在大小、位置或数量上改变以适应需要”覆盖可调座椅、可调扳手、可调利率三类典型对象；三维列举使定义可验证。
